market.headline: TSLA flips from morning green to -1% and QQQ drops 1.6% as chips keep selling into opex Friday
market.note: The early Roadster bounce is gone: TSLA tagged 370.58 then slipped under 363 and is now red on the day. SPY is down about 0.6% and QQQ about 1.6%, with INTC, MRVL, META and IREN leading the watchlist losses. Semiconductors are on an eight-day skid and leadership stays thin into monthly options expiration. Watch the last hour for pin risk near large SPY and QQQ strikes.

portfolio.note: Red now as the TSLA stack (TSLA, TSLL, TSLW) flipped after the morning bounce and QLD doubles the QQQ drop. The week is deeper red from the TSLA slide since last Friday.

catalyst.outlook: Inflation is still the story, and midday confirms the market knows it. Hot September import prices and strong industrial production kept rate-cut hopes on a short leash into the Oct 27-28 Fed meeting, and that hits long-duration tech first. Semiconductors are on their longest losing streak in years while SPY sits near highs, so the tape stays narrow. TSLA's Roadster bounce faded and the stock is red again into Wednesday earnings. Next week for you is Wednesday night: TSLA and META both report.

today.name: Import Prices (Sep)
today.read: Hotter than expected and August was revised down to 0.5%. Fuel imports rose 4.8% and nonfuel 0.7%. Year over year import prices are up 8.1%, the largest gain since July 2022. That keeps pressure on yields and growth names like TSLA and QQQ even as the index holds near highs.

today.name: Industrial Production (Sep)
today.read: A clear beat. Manufacturing rose 0.3%, utilities jumped 3.5%, and third-quarter IP ran at a 2.8% annual rate. Growth is holding up despite hot energy costs, which softens the stagflation read from this week's inflation prints.

today.name: Capacity Utilization (Sep)
today.read: Utilization moved up but remains 2.5 points below its long-run average, so factory tightness is not the main inflation driver. Still a mild hawkish tilt alongside hot import prices.

today.name: Monthly options expiration
today.read: Big SPY and QQQ option positions roll off today, which can pin prices near large strikes and cause sharp moves in the last hour.

week.name: Cboe extended options hours begin
week.why: Early morning and late sessions start for SPY, QQQ and more. Expect thinner liquidity and wider spreads in those windows.

week.name: NAHB Housing Market Index (Oct)
week.why: Builder mood with mortgage rates above 7%. A read on how rates are biting the housing side of the economy.

week.name: Housing Starts and Building Permits (Sep)
week.why: More housing data. Weak numbers would support the case for easier policy despite hot inflation.

week.name: Netflix earnings (after the close)
week.why: First mega-cap tech report of the season. Sets the tone for growth names into TSLA and META.

week.name: TSLA, META, IBM, LRCX, TXN earnings (after the close)
week.why: The big one for you. TSLA margins, robotaxi and Roadster plans, plus META AI spend and LRCX and TXN reads on the chip slump.

week.name: Initial Jobless Claims
week.why: Claims have hovered near 200K. A jump would be the first crack in the labor market.

week.name: S&P Global Flash PMIs (Oct)
week.why: First look at October activity and price pressures. Watch the prices-paid parts for oil pass-through.

week.name: UMich Sentiment, final (Oct)
week.why: Inflation expectations matter here. Rising expectations would make the Fed's job harder the week before its meeting.

stocks.title: Semiconductor stocks on an eight-day losing streak, about $2T erased
stocks.detail: Chip names keep sliding even as TSMC guided higher on AI demand. Traders blame hot inflation, AI spend doubts, and memory oversupply worries for NVDA, INTC and MRVL holders.

stocks.title: S&P 500 near a record while 200-plus members sit 30% off highs
stocks.detail: Traders call it a bear-bull paradox: a handful of AI mega caps carry the index while most stocks lag. Bulls see bargains if oil eases, bears see a fragile, narrow market.

stocks.title: Indonesia stocks crash hard on an MSCI downgrade threat
stocks.detail: MSCI opened a consultation on moving Indonesia out of emerging market status. The index saw its worst drop since 1998 and trading was halted amid panic selling.

stocks.title: MSCI rules could boot Strategy from global indexes
stocks.detail: New MSCI rules treat firms dominated by bitcoin holdings as non-operating. Strategy and Metaplanet top the possible deletion list after Nov 30, which could force passive selling.

tech.title: Tesla Roadster demo: SpaceX thrusters, midair flips, 2028 target
tech.detail: Tesla showed the next Roadster at SpaceX McGregor with cold-gas thrusters and upside-down driving. Performance to Rocket trims, 0-60 under a second, reservations open for 2028.

tech.title: NVIDIA and Mercedes expand partnership for automated driving
tech.detail: Mercedes is integrating NVIDIA Hyperion compute and Alpamayo AI into MB.OS for advanced assistance and future Level 4. Another software-defined vehicle push with OTA updates.

tech.title: Taiwan to criminalize unauthorized AI chip exports to China
tech.detail: Part of a 2026 U.S.-Taiwan trade deal. China is also drafting new AI and chip export controls. Escalating tech restrictions around the AI hardware boom.

tech.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark laptops arrive with Grace CPU and Blackwell GPU
tech.detail: ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI are shipping them with up to 128GB of unified memory for running AI models locally. Early tests put them near NVIDIA's DGX Spark desktop.

world.title: Iran vows to push US Navy ships farther from its coast
world.detail: Iran says US warships are already 500 km out and plans to force them farther, after claiming strikes on tankers east of Hormuz. Oil flows and prices stay tense.

world.title: Reuters: Iran struck Gulf infrastructure 135 times since February
world.detail: Precision hits on critical equipment in Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar and more. Experts say the damage is deeper than official debris claims, with heavy economic costs.

world.title: Singapore ship GFS Pride sinks in Strait of Hormuz after strike
world.detail: All 21 crew were evacuated safely. US CENTCOM said an IRGC projectile hit the vessel; Iran claimed a mine. Another reminder of risk in a key oil shipping lane.

world.title: Japan's top banks test a yen stablecoin for cross-border payments
world.detail: Mizuho, MUFG and SMBC finished a joint pilot with Mitsubishi UFJ Trust. Backed by Japan's FSA, they aim for commercial use by March 2027.

fact.claim: October is historically the S&P 500's worst month on average.
fact.explain: October has the scary reputation because of the 1929 and 1987 crashes, but its average return is positive. September is the month that has been weakest on average over the long run.

word.definition: Mental calm and steadiness, especially when things are stressful or going against you.
word.example: After a rough week, he met the premarket bounce with equanimity and stuck to his plan.

items.title: TSLA lost the 363 hold midday
items.detail: Range so far is about 356.88 to 370.58 after Thursday's 362.44 close. The morning Roadster bounce faded; holding above today's low matters more than the gap fill into Wednesday earnings.

items.title: Your book flipped with the TSLA stack
items.detail: You were green when TSLA was up about 1%; now the stack is red and QLD is still doubling the QQQ drop. Chip weakness remains the main drag into the opex close.

items.title: Chiefs: Rice still unlikely for Sunday
items.detail: Rashee Rice was DNP Wed and Thu with a hamstring/knee. Friday game statuses were not posted yet at midday. Walker still leads the NFL at 6.2 yards per carry vs the 0-5 Chargers.

items.title: Cool tech: NVIDIA plus Mercedes for robotaxis
items.detail: Mercedes is folding NVIDIA Hyperion compute and Alpamayo AI into MB.OS for advanced driving and future Level 4. Another real software-defined vehicle buildout, not just a press slide.

sports.title: Chiefs host the 0-5 Chargers Sunday at Arrowhead
sports.detail: Rice sat two straight practices and is unlikely to play. Simmons and Sneed were limited; Friday designations were still pending at midday. Watch Andy Reid's update before locking anything in.

sports.title: Kenneth Walker III leads the NFL at 6.2 yards per carry
sports.detail: 537 yards on 87 carries through four games in KC. The Chargers' run defense gets the next look on Sunday with Herbert under fire.

sports.title: Chargers injury list is long into Arrowhead
sports.detail: Tre' Harris doubtful with a hamstring; Derwin James, Donte Jackson, Joe Alt and others were DNP or limited. Ladd McConkey was limited with a foot issue.

sports.title: Lakers roster crunch hits Monday Oct 19
sports.detail: LA has to get to 15 players. Knecht-for-Sims talks with the Bucks look unlikely to land, so a waiver is still on the table if no trade clears.
